propositions: A code-review finding raised on one patchset but not re-emitted on the next reaches no consumer because payloads are keyed by (change_id, revision) and recall is non-deterministic per run
Findings must be classified into states (still-present, addressed, withdrawn) based on region changes between patchsets and prior carry-forward history to determine eligibility for carry-forward
Carried findings must never raise their posture (decision); a standing item can only lower or maintain the prior origin_decision, with unresolvable regions defaulting to still-present
Carry-forward is one-shot: an item already marked as carried (withdrawn state) must not be carried again, terminating the chain after one patchset
The reader (latest_code_review_result) must expose both the prior revision and the bucket (blocking vs advisory) each surfaced finding came from so that origin_decision can be determined and stamped

Standing findings resolved pre-workflow in gate_dispatch._assemble_code_review_run must be injected into merge_findings via a new standing_findings workflow input to reach code_review_verify_inputs without reaching finders
